headline: A 2006 executive order directed federal agencies to strengthen their work to protect Americans against identity theft.
what_it_does: This executive order, signed by President George W. Bush, aimed to improve how the federal government works to prevent identity theft and respond to it. No summary was provided, so the specific steps it required cannot be described in detail here.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies were directed to strengthen their efforts against identity theft.

who_it_affects.group: People whose personal information is stolen or misused
who_it_affects.how: The order was meant to improve federal protection against identity theft, though its specific measures are not described in the available material.
